correctness.rationale: Exact domain odd prime powers q≡3 (mod4). For q≥27, expansion of 3 character factors plus the classical Hasse–Weil squarefree cubic bound gives N≥(q−15−2√q)/8>0 for each triple/sign choice. Direct complete checks supply all triples at q19 and q23; these are the only remaining admissible q≥19. Standard four-round EF extension strategy proves uniform class. The sharp two-class rank-three theory follows from two-extension at q7 and q11, three-extension at q≥19, and a transitive-triangle witness. Acyclic triangle, acyclic 4-set and the explicit universal-existential triple sentence separate q3,q7,q11,q19. Exact four-vertex induced types at q11 and the 3-e.c. extension property prove existential stabilization at 11. Standalone verifier independently implements neighborhood bitsets and atom-type recurrence, with limitations stated.

originality.rationale: The closest works establish the order-19 threshold and broad 3-existential-closure results, but their inspected statements do not give the complete four-class rank-four logical classification over all odd prime-power Paley tournaments or its strict three-class existential-prenex threshold. Both distinctions are explicitly proved rather than treated as new versions of 3-e.c. itself; the remaining risk is an unindexed logical corollary in the literature.
residual_risks: 3-e.c. stabilization is already a published result for large prime Paley tournaments and substantially covered by a 2026 general theorem; the claim of originality is limited to the exact rank-four and existential-fragment classification, not the extension principle.

value.rationale: A complete natural bounded-rank invariant for all finite Paley tournaments over odd prime-power fields, with a sharp optimal 19-vertex representative cutoff and an exact earlier 11-vertex existential-fragment cutoff. The two-class rank-three threshold, followed by the formal rank-four alternation gap, isolates which extra universal-existential pattern distinguishes two tournaments whose every 4-vertex diagram already occurs in both, motivating this precise invariant beyond finite enumeration. Prior known 3-e.c. results are credited, not represented as the new mathematical content.
